description:
👉 TRY Topview MCP – https://www.topview.ai?via=julia

*One Amazon product link went into Claude. The customer reviews, the TikTok trends, the full campaign plan, and the finished video ad all came back in the same chat window.*

Topview MCP plugs four marketplaces (TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Shopee) plus image and *Seedance 2.5* video generation into the assistant you already use. Setup is one URL, with no API keys, no spreadsheets, and no fifth tab.

What you'll learn:
✅ Live *market research* from four platforms in a single prompt
✅ A campaign plan built on real reviews, with the *hooks* ranked
✅ A 15-second vertical ad, then the honest teardown of what's still a demo

The number one complaint across 90,000 reviews had nothing to do with cleaning.

#AI #AIMarketing #Ecommerce

First Movers is Julia's AI company focused on helping working professionals and founders create massive efficiency in their businesses and workplaces.
